name: Progressive strain hardening

name: Wave-equilibrium material
classification: mixed variational formulation; incomplete dynamical constitutive law
reason: Its local quadratic term is an energy law and its gradient term generates a variational interaction operator. Positive inertia, assumed only conditionally in LAB-001, is still needed for waves; amplitude hardening is absent.

name: Exponential hardening

name: Finite-extensibility material
